platforms.name: Radio One 91FM Dunedin Music Director Digital Download and Physical Airplay Route
platforms.country: New Zealand / Dunedin, Otago / student radio; official station material champions independent and alternative music from Aotearoa and beyond
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login or mandatory payment is stated for the official Music Director email or physical-delivery route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Radio One publishes music@r1.co.nz for music submissions and a separate physical-delivery address. Its linked alternative-radio guidance recommends a personal email, a descriptive subject, contact and origin details, a correctly named and tagged minimum-320-kbps MP3 download link, focus tracks and a one-page information sheet. The guidance is framed around New Zealand artists, while the station says it supports independent and alternative music from Aotearoa and beyond; international eligibility is therefore not explicit. A human must reconfirm that a Netherlands-based MarcsMusic release is eligible, select the appropriate track or release, verify rights, content labels and AI-origin acceptability, prepare the permitted download and metadata, and send manually. Physical delivery also requires manual handling.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from Radio One 91FM's official Contact, About, homepage and linked Getting Airplay on Alt Radio guidance. The Contact page names Maddy Barnes as Music Director, publishes music@r1.co.nz and maddy@r1.co.nz, explicitly labels music@r1.co.nz for music submissions, and provides a physical-submission address. The linked guidance recommends a minimum-320-kbps MP3 download link with correct naming and tags, contact and origin details, focus songs and a one-page information sheet. Radio One broadcasts 24/7 and lists indie-rock, techno, drum-and-bass, grime, ambient, reggae, electronica and other independent or alternative styles; the homepage showed live programming, a current Top 11 and a 2026 copyright notice. The queue uses only the purpose-bound role mailbox, not the named staff mailbox, to avoid duplicate outreach. Email verification was limited to official publication, valid syntax, first-party domain alignment, named staff context and stated submission purpose; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: Radio Control 99.4FM Palmerston North Music Submissions Email Route
platforms.country: New Zealand / Palmerston North, Manawatū / alternative student radio; the official site says it plays local music and tunes from throughout Aotearoa and the rest of the world
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login or mandatory payment is stated for the official Music Submissions email route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Radio Control's official Contact page publishes music@radiocontrol.org.nz specifically for Music Submissions, but it does not state accepted codecs, minimum bitrate, attachment or download-link method, release-age window, metadata, rights, content-warning, AI-origin or response requirements. The page also lists a postal address, but does not explicitly authorize it for physical music submissions, so it was not queued as a delivery route. A human must reconfirm current eligibility and international acceptance, request clarification if necessary, select a genre-appropriate MarcsMusic release, prepare a non-expiring stream or download only if permitted, verify rights and content labels, and send manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from Radio Control 99.4FM's official Contact, About and homepage pages. The Contact page publishes music@radiocontrol.org.nz under the explicit heading Music Submissions. The station describes itself as 100% alternative student radio, says it broadcasts 24/7 from Massey University, plays fresh local sounds plus music from throughout Aotearoa and the rest of the world, and carries special-interest shows across many genres. Current activity was confirmed through the 2026 site, weekly New Zealand Top Ten information, 2026 programming references and active listen and archive links. The published postal address was retained only as general contact context because the page does not state that unsolicited physical music is accepted. The business email was verified only through official publication, valid syntax, first-party domain alignment and explicit submission purpose; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
